data.one_liner: Custom scroll behavior and physics to scroll only when content exceeds available space.
data.what_it_does: Provides a custom ScrollBehavior and scroll physics that enable platform-specific scrolling behavior only when there is not enough space inside a scrollable widget. It helps prevent unnecessary scrolling behavior on platforms where it is not desired when content fits completely.
use_when: You want a scrollable widget to only scroll when its content exceeds the available space
You need platform-specific scrolling behavior based on content overflow
avoid_when: You always want scrolling enabled regardless of content size
strengths: Simple integration via ScrollConfiguration and ListView physics
data.minimal_example:
ScrollConfiguration(
    behavior: ScrollWhenNeededBehavior(),
    child: ListView(
        physics: ScrollWhenNeededPhysics(targetPlatform: Theme.of(context).platform),
        children: [
            Container(
                height: 100,
                color: Colors.amber,
            ),
            TextField(),
            Container(
                height: 300,
                color: Colors.amber,
            ),
        ],
    ),
),
